title: Keep widget settings aligned after duplicating a page
steps: Inspect Overview: Right is the visible widget, Left is collapsed in the tray, and the creator panel shows Right.
Choose Duplicate from the Overview page menu and save Overview (copy); inspect the visible widget and the creator panel.

video_guide.summary: Duplicate Overview and compare the visible Right widget with the Widget title field in the settings panel.

chapters.note: Overview shows Left in the collapsed tray, a visible Right table with a green active border, and Widget title Right in the side panel.
The page menu includes Duplicate page.

chapters.label: Choose Duplicate page and keep Overview (copy) as the name.

chapters.note: The Duplicate page dialog shows Overview (copy) and a Save button.
Overview (copy) is selected; Right is visible with the green active border and Left is in the tray, but the side panel reads Widget title Left.
The copied page still shows the visible Right widget beside Widget title Left.
